جَدِيرَةٌ An enclosure for camels, (AZ, S, K,) and for lambs and kids and calves &c., (TA,) made of masses of stone; (AZ, S;) as also ↓ جَدَرَةٌ : (TA:) if of mud, or clay, it is called ↓ جِدَارٌ : (AZ, TA:) or an enclosure (زَرْب ) for sheep or goats. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Nature; or natural, or native, disposition, temper, or other property. (K)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
